description: Regression-detection defaults. Contract, named baselines and config override; these only fire when no tighter source exists.

median_factor.rationale: current median >1.5x baseline median is a material shift, not noise

mad_k.rationale: |current - median| > 3.5 robust deviations is a breach

volatility_ratio.rationale: MAD above half the median means the series itself is unstable

improve_factor.rationale: current < 0.7x baseline median is a measurable improvement

min_baseline_samples.rationale: fewer than 3 baseline runs cannot bound a distribution

persistent_tail.rationale: 3+ consecutive breaches marks a persistent regression
